newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies finish mixed, yen widen losses.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies finish mixed, yen widen losses.

text.p: Oct 23 - IMM currencies finished mixed. Yen widened losses, with Dec setting a contract low at $0.008906. The old contract low of $0.008912 was set on GLOBEX. A wire service quoted an unnamed U.S. official expressing doubt that there would be a reversal of the progress made in narrowing the U.S.-Japan trade gap. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
